questions.q:
The following compound

can readily be prepared by Williamson ether synthesis by reaction between
questions.solution:
Williamson ether synthesis is the reaction in which an alkyl halide is allowed to react with alkoxide to give ether. The reaction involves ${S}_{N}2$ attack of an alkoxide ion on primary alkyl halide. In option $\left(a\right) and \left(b\right) there are alkoxide and alkyl halide, but option \left(b\right) is preferred because $I$ is better leaving group than ${Cl}^{-}$

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Upon reaction with $\mathrm{CH}_{3} \mathrm{MgBr}$ followed by protonation, the compound that produces ethanol is
questions.solution:
\($\mathrm{CH}_{3} \mathrm{CHO}+\mathrm{CH}_{3} \mathrm{MgBr} \rightarrow \mathrm{CH}_{3} \mathrm{CH}(\mathrm{OH}) \mathrm{CH}_{3}$\)
\($\mathrm{HCHO}+\mathrm{CH}_{3} \mathrm{MgBr} \rightarrow \mathrm{CH}_{3} \mathrm{CH}_{2} \mathrm{OH}$\)
\($\mathrm{HCOOH}+\mathrm{CH}_{3} \mathrm{MgBr} \rightarrow \mathrm{CH}_{4}$\)
So \($\mathrm{HCHO}$\) on reaction with \($\mathrm{CH}_{3} \mathrm{MgBr}$\) followed by protonation will produce ethanol.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Reaction of phenol with $NaOH$ followed by heating with ${CO}_{2}$ under high pressure, and subsequent acidification gives compound $X$ as the major product, which can be purified by steam distillation. When reacted with acetic anhydride in the presence of a trace amount of conc. ${H}_{2}{SO}_{4},$ compound $X$ produces $Y$ as the major product. Compound $Y$& is
questions.solution: Reaction of phenol with $NaOH$ followed by heating with ${CO}_{2}$ under high pressure and subsequent acidification gives salicyclic acid $\left(X\right)$ as the major product, which can be purified by steam distillation. When reacted with acetic anhydride in presence of a trace amount of conc. ${H}_{2}{SO}_{4},$ compound $X$ produces methyl salicyclate $\left(Y\right)$ as the major product.
